references.text: Here is told the birth of Joseph, Rachel's firstborn son, who is mentioned in Genesis 46:19.
These verses concern the birth of Benjamin, Rachel's second son, who is mentioned in Genesis 46:19.
Here Rachel's sons are summarized as Joseph and Benjamin, a direct parallel to the listing in Genesis 46:19.
Jacob refers to Rachel as his wife who bore him two sons, which directly mirrors the wording in Genesis 46:19.
The following verses list the sons of Joseph and Benjamin, who make up the concrete descendants of Rachel who went down to Egypt.
